description: Search Alt eSIM travel data plans. Filter by destination country slug (e.g. 'japan', 'usa', 'europe'), region, and/or max USD price. Returns plans with sku, data amount, validity days, USD price and coverage carriers. All prices are USD.

country.description: Destination country/region slug, e.g. 'japan', 'south-korea', 'thailand', 'usa', 'europe'. Omit to list all.
